# Gooey section edge: Twin, a liquid scroll effect between page sections

Main bulge plus a smaller blob beside it. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

[![Gooey section edge: Twin, a liquid scroll effect between page sections](demo/preview.jpg)](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gooey-section-twin/demo/)

[Open the live demo](https://loouis.github.io/skills/gooey-section-twin/demo/) · [Demo source](demo/index.html) · [Demo prompt](demo/PROMPT.md) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Rebuilds the 'Twin' gooey section edge from Louis's motion labs (gooey-sections.html, tab 6): the main pull with a smaller sympathetic blob rising beside it. The boundary between two page sections acts like a liquid surface driven by scroll speed. Use this skill whenever the user asks for the twin goo or twin edge, or wants a section edge with two blobs or a double bulge, or for gooey sections tab 6, on a plain HTML page, a Webflow site or a React/Next.js app, even if they only name the feel. It ships a verified 1:1 port of the lab engine, so the result matches the lab exactly.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/gooey-section-twin/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/gooey-section-twin`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $gooey-section-twin to add the twin gooey edge between the sections of this page."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.
